frontmatter.description: Bootstrap a fresh session — read HANDOFF.md (if present), tasks/current.md, recent commits, and surface the recommended next action. Use at the start of any session when context is empty or after a long gap.
Run the project's local verification pipeline. Use after any meaningful code change and before committing. Does not deploy.

frontmatter.name: docs-curator
frontmatter.description: Keeps this project's documentation aligned with reality. Use when code changes have outdated HANDOFF.md, README.md, ROADMAP.md, or an ADR; when a new architectural decision needs an ADR; or when docs contradict each other. Edits prose only — never code.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash

frontmatter.name: orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Plans a multi-step change in this project before any code is touched. Use when a task spans more than one file or has a non-obvious sequence — e.g. "implement X feature", "refactor Y module", "fix the bug chain in Z". Returns a step-by-step plan with critical files, risks, and a verification strategy. Does not write code.

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews a staged or recently committed diff in this project for correctness, safety, and convention compliance before it ships. Use after implementer finishes a non-trivial change and before commit/push. Read-only; does not edit code.
